# EveMarket Screener

> Free station-trading screener for EVE Online. Shows which items in The Forge (Jita) market are worth trading, ranked by ROI, spread and liquidity, with data refreshed every 4 hours.
> Available in English (default), Spanish, German, French and Italian — add `?lang=es|de|fr|it` to the URL.

The public Screener requires no account. The "My Orders" and "Settings" sections are private, for the site owner's personal use, and are not public content.

## What it does
- Classifies every item in the Jita market into four states:
  - Potential: spread, liquidity and real market activity over the last 7 days meet the criteria.
  - No orders: spread and liquidity qualify, but the executed-trade history is too low (little volume or few trades per day).
  - Under observation: borderline case, more history is needed.
  - Discarded: losing spread or unviable liquidity.
- Computes per item: best buy and sell price, spread, ROI, real daily volume and trades per day.
- Lets you filter and sort by category, ROI, spread, price and volume.
- Each item has a detail view with its recent price and volume history.

## Pages
- [Screener](https://evemarket-analyzer.online/): main listing, public.
- [Español](https://evemarket-analyzer.online/?lang=es) · [Deutsch](https://evemarket-analyzer.online/?lang=de) · [Français](https://evemarket-analyzer.online/?lang=fr) · [Italiano](https://evemarket-analyzer.online/?lang=it)

## Data and limits
- Source: the ESI, CCP Games' official API for EVE Online (not scraping).
- Region covered: The Forge (Jita).
- Frequency: the market engine runs every 4 hours; data can be that stale.
- Informational tool, not investment advice nor an in-game purchase recommendation.
- Independent site, not affiliated with CCP Games. EVE Online is a trademark of CCP hf.
